name: Aveline
story: She turned a small collection of overlooked artists into a welcoming gallery. Keeps a small collection, hosts intimate dinners, and buys slowly.
habits: Keeps a small collection, hosts intimate dinners, and buys slowly.
approach: Look for the detail everyone is missing.
mantra: My eye is worth trusting.

name: Nico
story: He started with a late-night show and learned to speak as if one person were listening. Keeps late hours, collects records, and talks to strangers.
habits: Keeps late hours, collects records, and talks to strangers.
approach: Start a conversation before trying to solve the whole thing.
mantra: My voice belongs in the room.

name: Imani
story: She prepares carefully, then makes her point without burying it in apologies. Reads widely, prepares carefully, and keeps her promises.
habits: Reads widely, prepares carefully, and keeps her promises.
approach: Separate what happened from what everyone is assuming.
mantra: I can say the difficult thing kindly.

name: Bea
story: She opens her studio doors before everything is perfect and lets people handle the pieces. Works in a messy studio, cooks by feel, and gives handmade gifts.
habits: Works in a messy studio, cooks by feel, and gives handmade gifts.
approach: Make a rough version you can actually look at.
mantra: My work deserves daylight.

name: Tessa
story: She built a tiny press around voices she wished she had found earlier. Runs a tiny press, rereads favourite books, and protects quiet mornings.
habits: Runs a tiny press, rereads favourite books, and protects quiet mornings.
approach: Decide what belongs here and cut one thing that doesn’t.
mantra: I can choose a direction and revise later.

name: Jules
story: They bring rough ideas to the table and ask what would make them useful. Builds prototypes, changes routines often, and carries a sketchbook.
habits: Builds prototypes, changes routines often, and carries a sketchbook.
approach: Turn the unknown into a question you can test.
mantra: A prototype teaches me more than a plan.

name: Malik
story: He runs a busy kitchen by naming priorities and making room for his team. Feeds friends, runs a busy kitchen, and takes Mondays off.
habits: Feeds friends, runs a busy kitchen, and takes Mondays off.
approach: Choose the priority and say who owns the next step.
mantra: I can lead with care and clarity.

name: Romy
story: She can turn a rainy launch into a lively gathering with one phone call. Throws lively parties, loves a last-minute invitation, and travels light.
habits: Throws lively parties, loves a last-minute invitation, and travels light.
approach: Work with what is here rather than waiting for the original plan.
mantra: I can adjust without losing my direction.

name: Dalia
story: She checks the facts, makes the call and lets the evidence guide her next move. Keeps detailed notes, checks sources, and takes long walks alone.
habits: Keeps detailed notes, checks sources, and takes long walks alone.
approach: Ask for the missing information before drawing a conclusion.
mantra: I can follow the question patiently.

name: Hana
story: She made a corner shop into a place people visit when they need a breath. Opens her flower shop early, arranges seasonal stems, and closes on time.
habits: Opens her flower shop early, arranges seasonal stems, and closes on time.
approach: Choose the useful detail that makes this feel considered.
mantra: Small beauty is real work.

name: Cleo
story: She brings warmth into a room and lets a new friendship unfold at its own pace. Dances in the kitchen, plans dates, and says when she likes someone.
habits: Dances in the kitchen, plans dates, and says when she likes someone.
approach: Let the other person see what you actually enjoy.
mantra: I am allowed to enjoy being known.

name: Theo
story: He remembers small details about people and makes unhurried room for them. Spends days outdoors, remembers birthdays, and keeps a few close friends.
habits: Spends days outdoors, remembers birthdays, and keeps a few close friends.
approach: Listen for the detail that matters to the other person.
mantra: Connection grows through attention.

name: Ada
story: She makes plans with a partner while preserving time for her own work and walks. Designs gardens, lives with a partner, and keeps solo weekends.
habits: Designs gardens, lives with a partner, and keeps solo weekends.
approach: Say what you want while leaving room for their answer.
mantra: I can love and keep my own shape.

name: Suki
story: She travels slowly, writes what she notices and returns home when she wants. Travels slowly, writes in cafés, and comes home when she misses it.
habits: Travels slowly, writes in cafés, and comes home when she misses it.
approach: Try a small detour and find out how it actually feels.
mantra: I can choose a path of my own.

name: Noemi
story: She left a prestigious office to work on smaller spaces she cares about. Runs a small architecture practice and turns down projects she dislikes.
habits: Runs a small architecture practice and turns down projects she dislikes.
approach: Check whether this is a choice you actually want to own.
mantra: I can build a life around my values.

name: Marta
story: She collects local stories and turns unfamiliar places into conversations. Lives out of a small bag, tells stories, and finds company everywhere.
habits: Lives out of a small bag, tells stories, and finds company everywhere.
approach: Find the interesting part and invite someone into it.
mantra: I can try a new chapter.

name: Kiran
story: He works from different places and chooses clients who respect his time. Works remotely, packs lightly, and keeps his calendar deliberately sparse.
habits: Works remotely, packs lightly, and keeps his calendar deliberately sparse.
approach: Sort out the practical constraint so you have more room to choose.
mantra: I can design my own terms.

name: Faye
story: She grows a small garden and sells enough handmade pieces to sustain her days. Grows food, makes pottery, and sells only what she can comfortably produce.
habits: Grows food, makes pottery, and sells only what she can comfortably produce.
approach: Ask what is enough for this to work well.
mantra: Freedom can be a slower life.

name: Hugo
story: He built a profitable shop by knowing his community and watching cash flow. Runs a neighbourhood bookshop, remembers readers, and reinvests carefully.
habits: Runs a neighbourhood bookshop, remembers readers, and reinvests carefully.
approach: Look for the choice you can keep repeating without burning out.
mantra: My work can grow at a human scale.

name: Estelle
story: She turned a personal craft into a small house with loyal customers. Makes perfume, collects unusual scents, and gives her work a dramatic launch.
habits: Makes perfume, collects unusual scents, and gives her work a dramatic launch.
approach: Present your choice as something you have deliberately made.
mantra: I can ask to be paid for my vision.
